script_text: Taurus, the cosmos is delivering a hard stop this week — the universe is slamming on your brakes, and it’s about to change everything. Wednesday transforms everything when Venus enters your 5th House of Love, bringing a surge of authentic romantic energy and creative inspiration back to your daily life — use this shift to pursue someone who feels safe rather than exciting. Jupiter trine Pluto activates your 8th House of Shared Resources mid-week, unlocking hidden financial opportunities or a debt resolution that feels almost miraculous. This is your moment to stop overworking and start receiving. Thursday through Sunday, the Moon enters passionate Scorpio, lighting up your 2nd House of Income — negotiate that raise, sell the asset, or renegotiate a contract; the stars are literally lining up your earnings. Sunday’s full moon on your Taurus Sun is your emotional culmination, demanding you claim your worth without apology. Follow for daily updates.
